assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries
There is a concern for intermittent arrhythmia as the underlying etiology of the collapse events
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is being claimed
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic periods
The service directly addresses the reason for the CPT 93229 claim
The service supports coverage eligibility for this diagnostic monitoring service
The diagnosis code R55 is associated with the patient's condition
The diagnosis code I25.10 is associated with the patient's condition
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
SilverBridge Advantage requires all non-emergency diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved
The patient may submit a formal appeal within ninety days of the notice
